title: Deterministic Protocol 128 Fast-Boot Lifecycle Hook & Zero-Turn Context Hydration
target_platform: macOS / APM Lifecycle Hooks (SessionStart) for Claude Code, Codex & AGY
hypothesis: Configuring a deterministic SessionStart lifecycle hook via APM (.apm/hooks/hooks.json) that runs guardian_wakeup.py --mode HOLISTIC --write-digest before turn 1 eliminates manual boot commands for incoming agents, guarantees Layer 1 memory hydration across CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity), and preserves startup latency under 500ms.
falsification_criteria: A clean agent session starts without executing the hook, the hook fails to produce .agent/learning/guardian_boot_digest.md, or total execution overhead exceeds 1,500ms.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if cross-platform lifecycle hook specification requires multi-agent orchestration
